maria: Quick flag from todays shadow on v4.2-int4: overall looks fine but the long-doc slice (>=2k tokens) shows ~5% MRR drop. We should lock an anchoring rule before any traffic split.

 kevin: Numbers? sample sizes and CI?

 maria: control 9.8k, variant 2.3k. overall delta -0.6%, long-doc delta -5.0%, bootstrap 95% lower = -0.046.

 li: Any token-level truncation or KV warmup signs in top regressions?

 maria: Yes, about 30% of top-100 regressions indicate prompt suffix clipping after KV merge. Ill attach examples.

 samir: Proposal: make canary rules CI-driven + per-slice minima + ensemble requirement. Minimal config: global_min=1000, long-doc min=500, comparator=bootstrap 95% lower, rel_abort_threshold=-0.03, sustained_windows=3 (window=1800s). Require two metrics (mrr + accept_rate) to both cross lower bounds for auto-rollback.

 kevin: Add an entropy/length proxy quick-fail: if avg_entropy drops >20% and mrr drops >2% -> immediate hold and human review.

 li: Also prefer human-only for tiny slices. Add per-slice auto_rollback_allowed flag.

 maria: Action items: 1) Ill attach top-200 pairs and open canary ticket. 2) Li to run token-diff on top regressions. 3) Samir to wire Optimize bootstrap into the canary checker. 4) Kevin to add entropy proxy check and update policy PR. 5) deploy-bot to run a dry-canary tomorrow 06:30 UTC.

 deploy-bot: [system] Scheduled dry-canary at 2023-11-12T06:30:00Z. Artifacts will be posted to /artifacts/canary/2160001111/. Policy draft "anchored-longdoc-v1" created.

 maria: Thanks all. Keep promotion locked until the anchored gate and smoke-paired-run are green. :lock:
